nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Review
nodes.rationale: People keep, revise, or retire decisions; the system raises evidence-backed alerts and never rewrites source documents automatically.

nodes.label: Organisational Memory and Decision Intelligence
nodes.rationale: Continuously compare new Workspace information against confirmed decision assumptions and preserve evidence and rationale for human review.

nodes.label: Full Production Implementation Contract
nodes.rationale: Defines production-grade Workspace sync, access control, processing, review, export, reliability, and validation behavior.

nodes.label: Idempotency and Optimistic Locking
nodes.rationale: State-changing operations use idempotency keys and revision checks to avoid duplicate effects and reject stale updates.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: Consult the version-specific Next.js guides before changing code because this version has breaking API, convention, and file-structure changes.

nodes.label: Dirty Graph Output Policy
nodes.rationale: Hook and incremental-update changes are expected; skip Graphify only when graph output is stale or incorrect or the user explicitly asks not to use it.

nodes.label: Query the Knowledge Graph First
nodes.rationale: For codebase questions, run graphify query first when the graph exists; use path and explain for relationship and focused concept questions.

nodes.label: Use Graphify Instructions on /graphify
nodes.rationale: When the user types /graphify, consult the installed Graphify skill or instructions before other work.
